SystemBootstrap.title: SystemBootstrap
SystemBootstrap.description: One-time initialization lock marking that the initial SnackFactory Owner account has been provisioned.

User.title: User
User.description: Authenticated SnackFactory ERP employee account with username, role-based access control, and organizational metadata.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication user UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Full display name of the ERP operator.

email.description: Internal Firebase Auth email identifier or verified contact email.

role.description: Assigned SnackFactory ERP role determining module permissions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile or role update.

lastLoginAt.description: Server timestamp of the most recent authenticated session.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Finished snack SKU master record with packet size, selling price, GST rate, and status.

RawMaterial.title: RawMaterial
RawMaterial.description: Ingredient or packaging material master record with stock levels, unit pricing, and reorder alert threshold.

Customer.title: Customer
Customer.description: Retailer or Distributor customer account with GSTIN, billing address, and state code.

Supplier.title: Supplier
Supplier.description: Raw material and packaging vendor master record with GSTIN, address, and state.

Purchase.title: Purchase
Purchase.description: Supplier purchase order header tracking supplier details, invoice reference, GST totals, payment status, and inventory receipt status.

PurchaseItem.title: PurchaseItem
PurchaseItem.description: Raw material line item belonging to a purchase order with quantity, unit price, GST rate, and line totals.

Bom.title: Bom
Bom.description: Versioned Bill of Materials header linking a finished snack product to batch yield and estimated raw material cost.

BomItem.title: BomItem
BomItem.description: Ingredient or packaging line item belonging to a Bill of Materials with required quantity, unit, and estimated material cost.

ProductionOrder.title: ProductionOrder
ProductionOrder.description: Batch production plan and execution record linking a finished snack product and BOM to raw material issuance, output quantities, and completion lock.

ProductionConsumption.title: ProductionConsumption
ProductionConsumption.description: Per-material expected, issued, actual consumed, damaged, and variance quantities for a production order.

StockBalance.title: StockBalance
StockBalance.description: Real-time categorized stock balance for raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, and damaged stock.

InventoryLedgerEntry.title: InventoryLedgerEntry
InventoryLedgerEntry.description: Immutable append-only inventory movement ledger entry recording quantities in/out, running balance, reference document, and responsible user.

ProductionVariance.title: ProductionVariance
ProductionVariance.description: Immutable yield and raw material consumption variance snapshot recorded upon completing a production order.

FactorySettings.title: FactorySettings
FactorySettings.description: Configurable SnackFactory legal name, address, state/stateCode, GSTIN, invoice numbering prefix, and atomic sequence counter.

SalesOrder.title: SalesOrder
SalesOrder.description: Customer sales order header with approval workflow, intra/inter-state GST totals, dispatch progress, and invoice link.

SalesOrderItem.title: SalesOrderItem
SalesOrderItem.description: Finished snack SKU line item within a customer sales order tracking ordered vs dispatched quantities and GST split.

Invoice.title: Invoice
Invoice.description: GST tax invoice generated once per approved sales order with CGST/SGST or IGST breakdown and live payment balance.

InvoiceItem.title: InvoiceItem
InvoiceItem.description: Immutable GST tax invoice line item with HSN code, taxable value, and CGST/SGST/IGST breakdown.

Dispatch.title: Dispatch
Dispatch.description: Immutable shipment dispatch record linked to an approved sales order, vehicle details, and partial-authorization tracking.

DispatchItem.title: DispatchItem
DispatchItem.description: Immutable finished product quantity line included in a dispatch manifest.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Immutable customer receivable payment linked to a GST tax invoice.

ProductionCosting.title: ProductionCosting
ProductionCosting.description: Batch manufacturing overhead expenses (labour, gas & electricity, other production expenses) linked 1:1 to a production order.

AuditLogEntry.title: AuditLogEntry
AuditLogEntry.description: Immutable chronological audit trail logging financial, costing, payment, and compliance events.

/system/{docId}.description: One-time system bootstrap lock ensuring initial Owner setup cannot be hijacked once initialized.

/users/{userId}.description: Primary ERP users collection storing username, role assignments, department, status, and timestamps.

/products/{productId}.description: Finished snack product SKUs, packet sizes, prices, GST rates, and status.

/rawMaterials/{materialId}.description: Raw material master records with stock balances and low-stock thresholds.

/customers/{customerId}.description: Retailer and Distributor customer records with GSTIN and billing details.

/suppliers/{supplierId}.description: Approved raw material supplier records with GSTIN and address.

/purchases/{purchaseId}.description: Supplier purchase order headers with subtotal, GST, grand total, payment status, and goods receipt status.

/purchaseItems/{itemId}.description: Raw material line items linked to supplier purchase orders.

/bom/{bomId}.description: Versioned Bill of Materials recipe headers linking finished products and batch material cost estimates.

/bomItems/{itemId}.description: Raw material ingredient quantities and units belonging to a Bill of Materials version.

/productionOrders/{orderId}.description: Batch production orders tracking planned/expected quantities, good/damaged outputs, and material issuance locks.

/productionConsumption/{itemId}.description: Expected vs. actual raw material consumption and variance per production order.

/stockBalances/{balanceId}.description: Current stock balances across raw materials, WIP, finished goods, and damaged stock.

/inventoryLedger/{entryId}.description: Immutable append-only stock movement ledger recording every inventory change and responsible operator.

/productionVariances/{varianceId}.description: Yield and material consumption variance summary documents for completed production runs.

/settings/{settingId}.description: Configurable factory legal GSTIN, address, state code, and atomic invoice counter.

/salesOrders/{orderId}.description: Customer sales orders with approval status, GST totals, dispatch fulfillment status, and invoice link.

/salesOrderItems/{itemId}.description: Finished product line items within customer sales orders.

/invoices/{invoiceId}.description: GST tax invoices generated atomically once per approved sales order with live payment reconciliation.

/invoiceItems/{itemId}.description: Immutable GST tax invoice line items.

/dispatches/{dispatchId}.description: Immutable shipment dispatch documents linked to approved sales orders and vehicles.

/dispatchItems/{itemId}.description: Immutable product quantities shipped per dispatch manifest.

/payments/{paymentId}.description: Immutable customer receivable payment receipts linked to GST invoices.

/productionCostings/{costingId}.description: Manufacturing overhead expense entries (labour, gas/electricity, other expenses) mapped 1:1 to production orders.

/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable chronological audit trail recording payment, costing, and compliance events.
